text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-i-s-t-e-d t-h-e s-t-o-c-k a-s "c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-d" w-i-t-h-o-u-t a n-y v-e-r-i-f-i-a-b-l-e p-r-o-o-f, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s o-n-l-i-n-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d o-r-i-g-i-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s u-s-i-n-g g-e-n-e-r-i-c d-a-t-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-r-y a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s i-n t-h-e i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s t-o m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-r-r-e-g-u-l-a-r t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-h-a-i-n o-f-c-u-s-t-o-d-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d b-o-g-u-s p-e-r-m-i-t n-u-m-b-e-r-s t-o a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g i-n-v-a-l-i-d a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l p-e-r-m-i-t v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-s-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d s-a-l-e-s t-o u-n-a-w-a-r-e b-u-y-e-r-s o-n o-n-l-i-n-e m-a-r-k-e-t-p-l-a-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-a-t-t-e-r-n o-f d-e-c-e-p-t-i-v-e m-a-r-k-e-t-i-n-g a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
